name: Calypso Bay Smokehouse
notes: 5 photos, all the same menu. Photos 1 and 4 are the same digital TV menu board with full prices (Entrees/Sides/Desserts/Kids/Beverages); photos 2, 3 and 5 are the same printed wall sign with matching Entrees/Sides/Desserts/Kids but with price boxes left blank (illegible), plus a section header calling the chicken salad 'Grilled Chicken Salad' and listing an extra dessert, S'mores Brownie, not on the TV board. Merged: used the TV-board prices, treated 'Grilled Chicken Salad' as the same dish as the priced 'Smoked Chicken Salad', and added S'mores Brownie with no price. Dropped the Beverages section (drinks only, no food).
